cameraDenied: No access to the camera, so video is off
cameraUnavailable: No camera found, so video is off
contactCannot: Your contact's app cannot take calls
contactOutdated: Your contact needs an updated Ghostly for calls

devices.failed: Could not use {{name}}. The call keeps the one it had.
devices.gone: {{name}} disconnected. Connect another to go on.

mediaDenied: No access to the mic or camera
mediaDeniedAndroid: Allow the microphone (and camera) in Android's settings for Ghostly.
mediaDeniedNext: Allow them in your browser or system settings.
mediaDeniedOneNext: Allow access in your browser or system settings.
mediaUnavailableNext: Connect one, or close the app using it.
micPaused: Your phone paused the mic. Keep Ghostly open to be heard.
noPathNext: A VPN or firewall, yours or your contact's, may block calls. A TURN server gets them through.
noPathTurnSet: It didn't get through your TURN server either. Check its address (TURN over TLS on 443) and credential, or your contact may need one too.
relayNoAnswerNext: Check the TURN server in Settings, Network. Hide my IP never connects directly.
relayOnlyNow: Call ended: Hide my IP is on
relayOnlyNowNext: This call reached your contact directly. Call again: it goes through your relay.
relayOnlyOff: Calls are off while Hide my IP is on
relayOnlyOffNext: This app's calls cannot use a relay yet. Turn it off in Settings, Network to call.
selfView: Drag to move, pull a corner to resize, double-click to reset

share.blockedNext: Allow screen recording for this app in your system's privacy settings.
share.contactCannot: Your contact's app cannot show a screen in this call
share.noScreen: There is no screen to share
share.notHere: Screen sharing is not available here
share.notOnLinux: Screen sharing is not available on Linux yet

sharing.both: You and {{name}} are sharing your screens

unavailableHere: Calls are not available in this app

window.small: Keep the call in a small window
